stem: A man wishes to cross a river in a boat. If he crosses the river in minimum time, then he takes 10 min with a drift of 120 m. If he crosses the river taking shortest route, he takes 12.5 min, find the velocity of the boat with respect to water (in m/min)?

assets.alt: Two vector triangles: least time with v_b straight across, and shortest path with v_b angled upstream so the resultant √(v_b² − v_r²) is straight across.
